correctness.rationale: PASS: A binary state on the outdegree-one directed n-cycle shifts exactly to S+t under every parallel firing step, so avalanche faces are the downward closure of all n cyclic translates. Dihedral support orbit reduction is mathematically valid (reflection induces an abstract simplicial isomorphism even though it reverses directed arrows). Independently implemented all-support canonicalization across 3<=n<=15,1<=k<=min(5,n), free face/coface elementary collapse, integer simplicial boundary matrices and SymPy Smith normal forms. This separate full 747-dihedral-class computation completed and reproduced exactly 111 classes at n=15,k=5, 14 exceptional supports all there, all first-homology torsion (Z/2)^2 and none in other degrees. Four cases have (rank H1,rank H2)=(1,0), ten have (2,1), all other configurations torsion-free. Torsion of H_{j-1} equals torsion of coker d_j because im d_{j-1} is a free subgroup and the quotient extension splits. The claimed length fifteen and five-chip threshold is confined to the EXHAUSTED finite domain; no extrapolation for n>15.
